The trace simulates slot 11 against ALLC, TFT, Pavlov, ALLD, and near-ALLC population members, and proposes changes: always defect on the last round, add a test defection at round 50 followed by an apology, and exploit if the opponent does not retaliate.

STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-with-forgiveness core with ALLD detection and DD-cycle breaking. Simulated a one-shot defection test at round 31 followed by cooperation at round 32, then checking whether the opponent cooperated in round 32 to detect exploitable opponents. Changed the strategy by adding the test and an exploit mode that defects unless the last outcome was DD, while retaining the TFT core for non-exploitable opponents.
